The output for every event must follow the task specification. Future events, task/condition IDs, hidden tests, filesystem, network, imports, clocks and ambient randomness are unavailable. Do not use them. All time and information you may use are in config, state and the current event. Use finite JSON values.

Return complete source, without Markdown fences. The program may be at most 10,000 UTF-8 bytes; aim for clear code within 3,000–7,000 bytes. No external dependencies. Use dense arrays and plain objects with enumerable own data properties only, without accessors, symbols, custom prototypes, cycles or serialization hooks. Do not perform unbounded search.

Every public correct example is a full input trace with its required per-event outputs. Incorrect examples are explicitly labeled counterexamples. They do not introduce new requirements. {"specification":"Config weights maps tenant IDs to positive integers. Build a fixed slot cycle by sorted tenant ID, repeating each tenant weight times. Start cursor=0 and empty per-tenant FIFO queues. Events add{tenant,id}, dispatch. Add rejects an id already pending in any tenant (status=duplicate); otherwise queues it (status=queued). Dispatch scans at most one cycle starting at cursor, takes the first nonempty tenant FIFO item, then sets cursor to the slot after that chosen slot modulo cycle length (status=sent). If all queues empty status=empty and cursor stays unchanged. Output {status,sent:id_or_null,queues:{every tenant:[pending IDs]},cursor}. Tenants always exist in config. Implement pure solve({config,state,event})->{state,output}; initial state is null. Only the current event is available; each named event uses a type field, e.g. {type:\"run\"}. Inputs have at most eight single lowercase ASCII-letter identifiers, safe integer quantities and at most 48 events. Return exactly the documented output fields after every event; state representation is unrestricted JSON. All identifiers and numeric fields shown in event forms are present; quantities and all intermediate arithmetic are safe integers. Integral JSON number spellings such as 1 and 1.0 are equivalent; booleans remain distinct from numbers. Regimes vary event order and timing: ordinary uses moderate capacity, boundary tests equality/empty cases, adversarial repeats stale/conflicting events, and shift uses smaller capacities or larger costs/delays within the same semantics. Generator regimes: Boundary weights are a:1,b:3,c:1; shift weights a:2,b:1,c:3 replace ordinary a:1,b:2,c:1, with eight job IDs and 70% add events instead of four IDs and 50%. Adversarial traces add adjacent repeated events, capped at 48; those events obey the same contract.","tags":["fairness","ordering","capacity","identity"],"title":"Weighted cyclic dispatch"}

Dispatch scans one cycle from the cursor and advances to the slot after the selected tenant.","holds":"function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var w=input.config.weights,n=Object.keys(w).sort(),cy=[];for(var i=0;i<n.length;i++)for(var j=0;j<w[n[i]];j++)cy.push(n[i]);var q={};for(i=0;i<n.length;i++)q[n[i]]=[];var c=0,exp=[];for(i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],st='queued',sent=null;if(e.type==='add'){var d=false;for(j=0;j<n.length;j++)if(q[n[j]].indexOf(e.id)>=0)d=true;if(d)st='duplicate';else q[e.tenant].push(e.id)}else{st='empty';for(j=0;j<cy.length;j++){var z=(c+j)%cy.length,t=cy[z];if(q[t].length){sent=q[t].shift();c=(z+1)%cy.length;st='sent';break}}}var qq={};for(j=0;j<n.length;j++)qq[n[j]]=q[n[j]].slice();exp.push({status:st,sent:sent,queues:qq,cursor:c})}return JSON.stringify(exp)===JSON.stringify(output)}","mapping":"The rule maps config.weights to the fixed cycle, state to cursor and pending queues, and each event to one status/output snapshot.","program":"function solve(x){var cfg=x.config,w=cfg.weights,n=Object.keys(w).sort(),cy=[],i,j;for(i=0;i<n.length;i++)for(j=0;j<w[n[i]];j++)cy.push(n[i]);var s=x.state,q,c;if(!s){q={};for(i=0;i<n.length;i++)q[n[i]]=[];c=0}else{q=s.q;c=s.c}var e=x.event,st,sent=null;if(e.type==='add'){var d=false;for(i=0;i<n.length;i++)if(q[n[i]].indexOf(e.id)>=0)d=true;if(d)st='duplicate';else{q[e.tenant].push(e.id);st='queued'}}else{st='empty';for(j=0;j<cy.length;j++){var z=(c+j)%cy.length,t=cy[z];if(q[t].length){sent=q[t].shift();c=(z+1)%cy.length;st='sent';break}}}var queues={};for(i=0;i<n.length;i++)queues[n[i]]=q[n[i]].slice();return{state:{q:q,c:c},output:{status:st,sent:sent,queues:queues,cursor:c}}}"}
